💰 🇩🇰 up to 57,000 DKK/month gross _(varies by seniority)

_Intro

Monta powers the EV charging ecosystem. With 300,000+ monthly users and millions of charge sessions every month, our platform accelerates the electrification of mobility.

This is a fast-moving place. The problems are hard, the pace is quick, and the bar is high. If you like real ownership, figuring things out, and seeing the direct impact of your work, you'll do well with us.

AI is not a nice-to-have at Monta. It's how we work. Engineers use Claude Code daily. We ship faster, make better decisions, and stay lean because of it. We expect everyone to push the boundaries of what's possible with AI, not just use it passively.

Our principles keep us grounded: Build Together & Finish, Sweat the Details, Customer First, and Aim for the Moon.

The best part of Monta is the people: sharp, ambitious, and good to be around. You'll be challenged, supported, and trusted to deliver.

The Role

We're looking for a Senior Engineer to join our Financial Services team, the team responsible for every euro that flows through Monta's platform. This is a hands-on, senior individual contributor role where you'll own the architecture and delivery of complex financial systems, working across teams to ensure we can scale reliably as we expand across Europe.

Financial Services is at an inflection point. Our transaction volume is growing fast and already processes millions of euros each month. We're building the next generation of our financial infrastructure, including new billing models and compliance capabilities to support expansion into new EU markets. The problems are hard, the stakes are real, and the work matters.

We need someone who takes full ownership of what they build. Not someone who waits for direction, but someone who sees what needs to happen, drives it forward, and delivers. You will own projects end-to-end, from technical design through to production, and you'll be accountable for outcomes, not just output.

You should also be someone who has embraced AI as a core part of how you work. We use Claude Code extensively across the Financial Services team for everything from writing and reviewing code to designing systems and exploring financial domain problems. We expect you to be an advanced AI user who actively finds new ways to leverage these tools to move faster and think better.

This Is What You Will Achieve

• Redesign Monta's financial backbone. You'll architect and build the new invoicing system that every customer will use, replacing the current infrastructure with a foundation built for serious scale.

• Unblock EU expansion. You'll build the compliance infrastructure (e-invoicing, fiscalization, VAT) that enables Monta to enter new European markets.

• Strengthen the money flow. You'll improve the reliability and scalability of payment processing, reconciliation, and withdrawal systems across a rapidly growing transaction volume.

What You Will Do

• Own the new invoice system end-to-end. Design and deliver a new invoicing architecture that supports multiple billing models and financial flows as the business scales into new markets.

• Build and scale compliance infrastructure. E-invoicing across European markets. Fiscalization integrations. A VAT engine that handles the complexity of cross-border EV charging.

• Improve payment flows from card to payout. Card payments, automated reconciliation, withdrawal reliability, and working capital management.

• Collaborate across Finance, Legal, Revenue Operations, and Product to deliver new billing and commercial models. You won't work in a silo.

• Drive architecture decisions for systems that must be right. Every euro must be traceable from summary down to line item. You'll design for auditability, correctness, and scale.

• Elevate the team around you. Contribute to the growth of the Financial Services engineering team through code reviews, design discussions, and knowledge sharing.

What We're Looking For

• Strong backend engineering experience. You've built and maintained production systems at scale. Java/Kotlin preferred, but strong engineers from other stacks are welcome.

• Experience with financial systems. Billing, invoicing, payment processing, or similar domains where correctness and reliability are non-negotiable.

• Proven ability to own architecture across teams. You don't just write code, you shape systems. You've led technical design for complex projects that span multiple teams.

• A strong sense of ownership. You take responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks. When something needs to happen, you make it happen. You don't wait to be asked.

• Comfortable navigating ambiguity. Regulatory landscapes shift, business models evolve, and priorities change. You bring structure where there is none.

• Curiosity about financial infrastructure. Invoicing, VAT, compliance, payment flows. You don't need to be a domain expert on day one, but you're eager to go deep.

• Advanced AI adoption. You already use AI tools daily in your engineering workflow and you're always looking for new ways to apply them. You don't just accept suggestions, you prompt deliberately, iterate on output, and integrate AI into how you design, build, and debug.

• Strong collaboration and communication skills. This role sits at the intersection of engineering, finance, legal, and product. You build alignment fast and communicate clearly with non-technical stakeholders.

**Bonus

**

• Experience with EU financial regulations, e-invoicing standards, or fiscalization

• Experience with payment service providers or payment infrastructure

• Familiarity with event-driven architectures (Kafka) or high-throughput data processing

**If the mission excites you but your experience isn't a perfect 1:1 match, apply anyway. We care about potential, not perfection.

**AI at Monta Engineering

• AI is central to how we build software at Monta. It's not a side experiment. It's embedded in our daily work and we expect every engineer to be a power user.

• Tools we use daily:

• Claude Code for writing, reviewing, and refactoring code, exploring domain problems, and building internal tooling

• Claude / Gemini for research, design thinking, and documentation

• Notion AI for docs, knowledge management, and meeting notes

• AI-enhanced testing and monitoring

We expect you to bring a strong opinion on how to use AI effectively in engineering. If you've built custom workflows, pushed the limits of agentic coding, or found creative ways to use LLMs in your development process, you'll fit right in.

Why Monta

• Impact, not easy mode. Your work matters, and you'll feel it every day.

• Ownership from day one. We don't micromanage, we expect you to deliver.

• The people are extraordinary. Talented, driven, and fun to work with. You'll be challenged, supported, and inspired in equal measure.

What We Offer

• A yearly education budget and extra days off to use it.

• A friendly and social company culture with movie nights, Friday bars, pub crawls, and more.

• Free lunch every day.

• Pension & health coverage to keep you secure for today and tomorrow.

• Paid parental leave to support life's big moments.

• Warrants program - be part of our growth story.

• Flexible working hours; as long as you're at key meetings and delivering great work, we trust you to manage your schedule.

Please send us your application in English.

To succeed in this position, your spoken and written English skills need to be proficient. Since Monta is a globally active company, you'll be communicating often and regularly with our co-workers and partners around the world, making your professional English knowledge essential.

Please note that we don't accept unsolicited applications from headhunters or recruitment agencies. Unsolicited applications sent to our company or co-workers are considered to be the property of Monta, and we won't agree to pay any referral compensation or recruiter fee without a signed agreement.

Find out more by visiting https://monta.com/uk/careers/

Monta is building the platform that powers the future of EV charging. We connect hardware, software, businesses, and drivers into one seamless ecosystem. Our mission is to make charging simple, reliable, and scalable for everyone.

jobs.occupation: Part-time web developer (React/Django) for bioinformatic web tools - DTU Food
jobs.description:
DTU National Food Institute, Research Group for Genomic Epidemiology (Genepi), is looking for an independent part-time employee with interests in programming and software development to help us with support and maintenance of our bioinformatic web-tools. 

The position is not time-limited and is about 10-15 hours per week, on-site at DTU Lyngby with some flexibility. It suits an MSc student in Human-Centered Artificial Intelligence, software engineering, computer science or a related field.

The job
Your tasks will include:

• Develop and maintain the frontend and backend of our web tools, using React and Django.
• Improve usability, responsiveness and visual consistency across the tools.
• Provide technical support: troubleshoot problems and answer user emails (mostly in English).
Our expectations of you
Required qualifications are:

• Hands-on experience building web applications with React (or a similar modern JavaScript framework) and Python/Django.
• Experience with Git and relational databases (e.g. MySQL, PostgreSQL).
• Real-world experience: at least one year of professional, freelance or substantial open-source web development.
• Experience with Linux servers or the command line.
• Able to take a task from specification to deployment on your own.
• Good written English.
The ideal candidate has an interest in UX/user-centred design and has familiarity with bioinformatics or our tools. This is not required, and we'll teach you the domain.

What we offer in return
We offer an interesting and challenging job in an international atmosphere with the focus on research, teaching, innovation and scientific advice for the benefit of the surrounding community. We place emphasis on a high level of professionalism among our staff, so skills development is an integral part of our organization. We offer a great flexibility in the position. In the area of technical and natural sciences, DTU is one of the leading research and education institutions in Europe.

You can find more information about the institute at DTU National Food Institute and the research group at Genomic Epidemiology

Salary and appointment terms
The appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). In addition, supplements can be negotiated in accordance with DTU’s salary structure for academic staff employed in technical-administrative positions at DTU (AC TAP): https://www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures

The position is a part-time position. Starting date is 1 January 2027 (or according to mutual agreement).

The workplace is DTU Lyngby Campus.

Application and contact
Please submit your online application no later than 4 December 2026. 

Open the “Apply now” link, fill out the form and attach your motivated application, CV and exam certificates. 

Additionally, your application must include: 

• A link to your GitHub or portfolio showing web projects you build. Make sure the link is publicly accessible.
• A short answer (max. 150 words) to this question: Describe a web application you built with React and/or Django, and what your role was.
Applications that do not include both a link to code or a portfolio and an answer to the question above will not be considered.

If you would like additional information about the position, please contact Senior Researcher Rolf Sommer Kaas, rkmo@food.dtu.dk. Please note that we cannot answer questions about exemptions from the requirements or give feedback on individual CVs.

Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.

DTU National Food Institute
DTU National Food Institute conducts research into and disseminates - through advice, innovation and teaching - sustainable and value-creating solutions in the area of food and health for the benefit of society. The vision is to make a difference by generating future prosperity through research into food and health. The institute works to prevent disease and promote health, develop new and better food products for a growing population and create sustainable technological solutions, including biosolutions. The institute’s tasks are carried out in interdisciplinary collaboration within e.g. nutrition, chemistry, toxicology, microbiology, epidemiology, modelling, and technology. This is achieved through a strong academic environment of international top class with correspondingly skilled researchers and employees. The Institute employs approximately 400 staff members.

DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829
DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.

Location: Copenhagen, Denmark (HQ)

Join Saxo, as a Senior Product Owner to help shape the digital experience behind Saxo's Global Website.

**About The Job

**We are looking for a highly structured and analytical Senior Product Owner to help shape and evolve the digital experience of Saxo’s global website – Home.saxo. Our global website is an essential part of our customer journey.

You will work across marketing, business and technology, to collaborate closely with designers, web operations, engineering, content, SEO/GEO, CRO, media, analytics, and local website owners across our 11 markets.

Your role is to turn ideas, customer needs and business priorities into clear product direction and scalable digital solutions for Home.saxo – taking initiatives from concept through to implementation and continuous improvement.

The role comes with significant ownership and autonomy. You will own day-to-day product priorities, form clear recommendations, and make decisions within your area. You will work closely with the Head of Websites and Owned Media and senior stakeholders on strategic priorities and major trade-offs.

As a Senior Product Owner, you will join the Websites & Owned Media department reporting directly to the Head of Websites and Owned Media. The department sits in Saxo’s global marketing organization and brings together 30 passionate and skilled individuals from various cultures and countries. Together we work dynamically across Web Operations, UX/UI, SEO/GEO, CRO, content and engineering, to create a globally consistent but locally relevant Home.saxo experience.

You will work with a variety of global and local stakeholders across the business, to turn customer and business needs into scalable digital solutions and continuously improve how we build, manage and optimise Saxo's websites globally.

**Responsibilities

**

• Own and drive the website product roadmap & capabilities, setting priorities and making clear trade-offs based on customer value, business impact, effort, risk and strategic priorities.

• Bridge experience and execution, working with design, business, engineering and web operations to turn concepts into scalable solutions, clear implementation requirements and reusable capabilities.

• Translate concepts into clear requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria that development teams can act on.

• Work with engineering and solution architects to challenge, refine and validate solutions, ensuring they are scalable and fit for purpose.

• Ensure solutions support global consistency and local relevance, with clear principles, components and guidelines that enable web operations and market website owners to adopt and scale them.

• Drive UAT and release readiness, ensuring solutions meet experience, functional, accessibility, content and business requirements – including proper documentation.

• Use data, customer insights, and experimentation to measure impact and continuously improve website experience.

• Ensure accessibility is considered throughout the product lifecycle, and that website capabilities align with WCAG standards and regulatory requirements.

**Your Profile

**We Are Looking For a Senior Digital Product Professional Who Combines Customer Focus, Commercial Understanding, And Technical Confidence. Ideally, You Have Experience Within Several Of The Following

• 7+ years of experience in digital product management, website development, digital experience, marketing, or a similar field.

• Experience as a technical Product Manager, Product Owner or similar, working across business, design and engineering.

• Experience with complex websites, CMS platforms, or digital ecosystems. Sitecore or a comparable enterprise CMS is highly desirable.

• A solid understanding of web technology and architecture, including APIs, content rendering, caching, frontend/backend integration and key web performance concepts such as Core Web Vitals.

• Experience translating concepts and designs into scalable digital solutions and components.

• Stakeholder management skills, with the ability to navigate competing priorities, challenge constructively and make clear recommendations.

• Experience working in a global organisation, balancing global consistency with local market needs.

• Experience within the financial sector is a plus.

As a person, you are curious, highly structured, and pragmatic. You are comfortable navigating ambiguity and excel at breaking down complex business challenges into clear problem statements, desired outcomes, and actionable opportunities. You are comfortable making decisions and taking ownership. As well as turning concepts into reality by focusing on the details needed, to turn an idea into something that works in practice.

You recognise when broader alignment or senior stakeholder input is needed and are confident in navigating different perspectives to move things forward.

Furthermore, you are open to new ways of working, including AI-powered tools, and look for opportunities to automate repetitive tasks, improve quality, and focus on higher-value work.

We look forward to receiving your application.

**We get curious people invested in the world

**When you work at Saxo, you become a Saxonian and part of a purpose-driven organisation, where good ideas are always taken seriously, and where you can make a true impact. We are invested in your development, and you can expect a robust career from day one when you join Saxo – no matter which role you take on.

You will join 2,500 other ambitious colleagues across 11 countries and become part of an international organisation. Working in Saxo, you will get to meet colleagues from many different cultures and backgrounds, and you should know that we value diversity and inclusion and see it as a genuine source of strength to drive growth, foster innovation and position us for long-term success.

We encourage an open feedback culture and supportive team environments enabling employees to grow and fulfil their career aspirations.

When you bring passion, curiosity, drive and team spirit, your learning journey will be dynamic and your career opportunities in Saxo will be immense.

At Saxo we don’t just offer a job – we offer an opportunity to invest in your future!

**How To Apply

**Click here to create an account and upload your resume and a short motivation. We look forward to getting to know you better!

Economist Student Helper Lyngby

Permanent

**Do you enjoy working with data, economic analysis and solving complex problems? Can you turn numbers and insights into meaningful solutions that contribute to a more sustainable future? Are you looking to apply your academic knowledge to real-life projects while gaining valuable experience in a leading consulting company? Then you might be our new Economist Student Helper!

** **Create the solutions that will shape a better tomorrow

**Your skills. Our team. Together, we design the future.

**Working hours and flexibility

**You will be employed on an hourly paid contract, with a standard working time of eight hours per week. We offer flexibility during exam periods, and there may also be periods when it would be beneficial if you could work additional hours.

**A place to work and so much more

**At COWI, we work together with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. We support our customers’ transition towards increased sustainability. We strive to lead by example by embedding environmental management, social responsibility and good governance into our business practices and the options we provide to our customers.

We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and having fun. Because that is what brings out the best in you, at work and at home. Learn more about our projects, strategy, ambitions and life at COWI at www.cowi.com.

**Diversity is fundamental to COWI, and inclusion is integral to the way we work.

jobs.occupation: Research Assistant within Trapped Ion Quantum Technology (re-advertisement)
jobs.employer_name: Natural Sciences - Institut for Fysik og Astronomi
jobs.description:
The Department of Physics and Astronomy (IFA), Aarhus University, Denmark (www.phys.au.dk) invites applications for a 2-year research assistant position with focus on establishing and maintaining trapped ion quantum technology setups. The work will partly be carried out in the newly established Quantum Tech-nology Lab (QTL) and within the Ion Trap Group.

The position is open from 1 February 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter. 

Your profile
The candidates are expected to have experience in cold trapped ion research, and hence both have experience in ion trap and laser technology. We are seeking enthusiastic candidates with a keen interest in setting up a new teaching ion trap setup in QTL as well as participate in maintaining and running ion trap experiments within the Ion Trap Group. More specifically, the candidate should have a solid background in construction and operating rf ion traps, CW laser systems including control of output powers, polarization states, linewidths and frequencies, as well as an understanding of analog and digital electronics for experimental control. Relevant methodology includes UHV vacuum handling, rf circuity electronics, laser frequency stabilization using optical frequency combs, rubidium atomic clocks, and GPS synchronization.

Applicants must be able to document relevant experience, as outlined above.

Who we are / The department
The Department of Physics and Astronomy is a department at the Faculty of Natural Sciences, Aarhus University, Denmark. The main objectives of the Department are to carry out research at the highest interna-tional level, to offer research based teaching at Bachelor of Science, Master of Science and PhD levels, and to exchange knowledge with other areas of society, e.g. by offering our expertise to industrial partners and the business world.

The Department is an attractive workplace for researchers, teachers, technicians, laboratory technicians and administrators and has a good study environment with many talented and active students at all levels. The research at the Department of Physics and Astronomy is of high quality, attracts significant international attention – in several fields the Department is within the world elite – and is characterized by many international collaborations with other high-ranking universities and research institutions around the world.

The place of work is Ny Munkegade 120, 8000 Aarhus C and the area of employment is Aarhus University with related departments.

The successful candidate is offered
• a working climate inviting lively, open and constructive discussion within and across different fields of research
• a working environment with teamwork, close working relations, and social activities
• a workplace characterized by professionalism, equality and a healthy work-life balance
• a job where the overall environment in Denmark is family-friendly, safe and relaxed – contributing to Denmark consistently being voted amongst the happiest nations in the world.
 
Job description
Your tasks include:

• Establishing and running a novel linear rf ion trap setup for teaching purposes
• Handling existing CW laser systems including commercial external cavity diode laser systems, TiSa-lasers, fiber-lasers for trapped ion experiments
• Handling (electro-)optical setups for controlling the frequency and shaping the power level of CW laser
• Help developing experimental control systems based on the platform ARTIQ (ARTIQ)

Contact information
Further information can be obtained from Michael Drewsen (drewsen@phys.au.dk)

Deadline
The application deadline is 13 December 2026. 

Application procedure
Short-listing is used. This means that after the deadline for applications – and with the assistance from the assessment committee chairman, and the assessment committee if necessary, – the head of department selects the candidates to be evaluated. The selection is made on the basis of an assessment of who of the candidates are most relevant considering the requirements of the advertisement. All applicants will be notified within 6 weeks whether or not their applications have been sent to an expert assessment committee for evaluation. The selected applicants will be informed about the composition of the committee and will receive his/her assessment. 

Formalities and salary range
Natural Sciences refers to the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Danish Universities under the Danish Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation.

The application must be in English and include a curriculum vitae, degree certificate, a complete list of publications, a statement of future research plans and information about research activities, teaching portfolio and verified information on previous teaching experience (if any). Guidelines for applicants can be found here.

Appointment shall be in accordance with the collective labour agreement between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Further information on qualification requirements and job content may be found in the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Danish Universities.

Salary and terms as agreed between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Confederation of Professional Unions at basic salary steps 4-8.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

The application must be submitted via Aarhus University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aarhus University's website.

About Aarhus University

Aarhus University is an academically diverse and research-intensive university with a strong commitment to high-quality research and education and the development of society nationally and globally. The university offers an inspiring research and teaching environment for its 37,500 students, including PhD students, and has 9,000 employees (full-time equivalents) and an annual revenue of EUR 1.2 billion. Learn more at international.au.dk

We are looking for an engineer who wants to build the foundation of our new Integrations effort: the connectors that bring our customers' data from third-party systems into the Trackunit platform. The connectors you build directly support our new partnership business, one of our key goals for next year. You will be among the first developers on this project, designing a reusable architecture and working directly with the engineers behind the systems we connect to, as well as seeing customer feedback shape what you build next. You might have a couple of years or be an experienced senior engineer, either way, we would be interested in seeing your application for this role.

**What's in it for you?

**

• Shape how the work gets done. Join a new, small team set up next to an established platform team, and help define how integrations get built here.

• Hear directly from the people using what you build. Customer feedback feeds straight back into the roadmap, and we act on it quickly.

• Collaborate beyond your own codebase. You’ll have regular, technically focused conversations with developers from the systems we connect to.

• Learn from experts who share. You’ll work with experienced domain experts who are open to sharing what they know, so you learn quickly.

• See your work ship. We favour small, frequent releases over long project cycles, so progress is visible fast.

**Who are you ideally?

**You are a backend developer with strong Java skills, just as comfortable at the edges where systems meet as inside your own codebase.

• Strong hands-on experience with Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, and REST APIs, in particular consuming data from other systems, in a microservice architecture.

• Experience designing new, reliable, reusable architecture for integrating with multiple systems. System-to-system integration experience is what we value most.

• You are comfortable discussing technical feasibility and approaches with third-party technical teams.

• You care what happens when data moves between systems, so you build with quality, observability and reliability in mind and you know quickly when something breaks.

• You are motivated by incremental delivery, enjoy getting close to the data, and like building new foundations from scratch.

You embrace AI as part of how you engineer. From prototyping through to production, you use AI tools as an integrated part of your workflow, not as a shortcut but as a force multiplier. That said, this isn't the main thing we're hiring for: curiosity and a willingness to use it well matter more than deep prior experience.

Don't meet every single requirement? No worries, this is what we're looking for ideally. If you're excited about this role but your background doesn't align perfectly with every point above, we encourage you to apply.

**Primary Responsibilities

**

• Design a reusable architecture for integrating with multiple third-party systems, not one-off solutions.

• Build connectors that collect data from third-party systems, usually ERPs, mainly by consuming their REST APIs, and bring it reliably into our platform.

• Understand the data you collect and transform it into Trackunit's data model.

• Work with third-party vendors: discuss technical feasibility and approaches with their technical counterparts.

• Build with quality, observability and reliability in mind, on our microservice and event-driven architecture.

****Our hiring process

****Don’t waste your time writing the perfect cover letter. We want you to create an impact that matters - and that’s not in the cover letter.

• Initial phone conversation with a colleague from our P&T team.

• Virtual meet and greet with your potential new leader and someone from the team, so you’ll get to know the role and team better.

• Assignment-specific interview with the hiring manager and a lead engineer from the team. We want to give you a real insight into the work. You’ll receive a case to prepare ahead of the interview and present to relevant colleagues - people you’ll also work closely with in the role.

• If needed, we will obtain references from former employers and conduct background checks at relevant levels.

• Offer presentation and walk-through.

**Coming Together To Connect Construction

**We’re committed to construction - one of the largest industries in the world. Over the past two decades, Trackunit has been pioneering technological progress within construction. Today, we are not only a leading IoT provider but a thought leader, supporting and shaping the agenda for an entire industry on a global scale.

We believe in taking a people approach in everything we do. Being human-centric is not restricted to our products - it’s a way of life at Trackunit. We’re proud to be a truly global team. Our colleagues come together in hubs spread across the globe, but we embrace the idea of working remotely and in environments that inspire you. Everything we do, we do to eliminate downtime and build the most useful industry for the world.

The question is: Are you in?

People & Organization

**Bring structure, service and ownership to every step of the employee journey

**Are you a detail-oriented P&O professional who enjoys working with people, processes and systems? Join Xellia’s Copenhagen P&O team for a one-year interim assignment and help deliver high-quality support across the entire employee lifecycle – from hire to retire.

Working close to the business

You will join a small, collaborative P&O & Payroll team in Copenhagen, supporting our Danish and Norwegian organisations and working with international colleagues. With four colleagues in the local team and approximately 18 across global P&O, you will have varied responsibilities, direct contact with employees and managers, and the opportunity to contribute to improvements in how we work.

Your role – make things happen

You will provide reliable day-to-day P&O administration and practical support across the hire-to-retire process, including:

• Prepare employment contracts, addendums and other documentation; keep employee and payroll-related data accurate and up to date.

• Support recruitment activities, including interviews, assessments and candidate feedback, and help organise onboarding and introduction days.

• Manage employee changes and offboarding in P&O, payroll, time and leave systems; respond to questions from employees and managers.

• Support annual P&O processes, including bonus and salary review cycles and administration linked to collective agreements.

• Maintain P&O policies, templates, digital personnel records and approval workflows, supporting compliance and audit readiness.

• Prepare P&O and payroll-related data for internal and external stakeholders and share relevant updates with leaders.

• Contribute to ad hoc P&O projects, including opportunities to simplify and automate processes using digital tools and AI.

jobs.occupation: Postdoc of Environmental Economics and Management
jobs.description:
The position is tied to three interdisciplinary European projects, MOSAIC, INTERCEDE and the upcoming Wild2050 project, which combine environmental valuation, environmental policy, and land use planning. The position is open from March 1st, 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter, and it is a two-year position.

  In MOSAIC, the role will be primarily one of coordination: the postdoc will liaise with the leads of project’s case studies and synthesise results across cases, with a focus on the uptake of land use policy instruments and comparison of methods. This requires strong communication, organizational skills, and the ability to work independently with multiple international research partners. In INTERCEDE, the work will involve analyses around the demand for forest ecosystem services, and in Wild2050 how demand for biodiversity conservation may change towards 2050. Across the projects, this research will require experience with quantitative methods including monetary and non-monetary valuation as well as cross-country analysis all in an interdisciplinary setting.

  The postdoc’s duties will include research in environmental economics and management, as well as contributing to project reporting. The position may also include teaching or other duties.

  Further information on the Department is linked at https://www.ku.dk/ifro/en. Inquiries about the position can be made to Professor Jette Bredahl Jacobsen jbj@ifro.ku.dk or by phone +45 35 33 17 46.

  Physical presence at IFRO is considered as a natural part of being an employee to contribute to a welcoming, socially pleasant, creative and innovative work environment. IFRO offers possibility for flexibility and working from home, but an employee is expected to regularly be present physically at IFRO.

  The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

  Terms of employment

  The position is covered by the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff.

  Terms of appointment and payment accord to the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State.

  Negotiation for salary supplement is possible.

  You can read more about salary levels in the state sector www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish).

  The application, in English, must be submitted electronically by clicking APPLY NOW below.

  When you will be affiliated with the University of Copenhagen or otherwise have access to their research, you may be required to undergo a background screening. The purpose is to protect the security and research integrity of the University of Copenhagen.

  Please include 

   	
• Curriculum vitae 	
• Diplomas (Master and PhD degree or equivalent)

• Complete publication list 	
• Separate reprints of 3 particularly relevant papers   The deadline for applications is 14 December 2026, 23:59 GMT +1.
